title: Astro Portal API v1 devices of a space
description: The devices of a space: list, rename, detach, attach a device that belongs to another space, the limit of one change of space per 24 hours. See v1.md, section « Space devices ». Clients ignore fields they do not know.

current.description: True for the device that makes the call.

appVersion.description: The version and build (`1.0.4+126`) the device's `X-PlanAstro-Client` header last named; null until it sends one. Additive: an older service omits it.

osVersion.description: The system and its version (`iOS 18.1`) the same header last named; null until it sends one. Additive: an older service omits it.

renameRequest.description: PATCH /v1/devices/{deviceId}; the answer is the renamed `spaceDevice`.

maskedEmail.description: The address of another space, shown without revealing it: its first character, an ellipsis, then the domain (`v…@exemple.fr`).

attachedElsewhere.description: 409 of POST /v1/sign-in/verify (`client: app`, `application: planner`) when the phone is attached to another space. The code is used: `attachment.token` stands for the proven address during ten minutes, once.

attachRequest.description: POST /v1/sign-in/attach: « Rattacher cet appareil à mon espace ». The answer is the `verifiedForApp` body of sign-in.schema.json, `created` being that of the verification which issued the token; the former space receives a message; its copy is erased from the device by the application. A token unknown, used or more than ten minutes old answers 400 `sign_in_code_expired`; a device other than the one the token was issued to, 400 `invalid_request`.

changeLimited.description: 409 of POST /v1/sign-in/attach, of DELETE /v1/devices/{deviceId} by the device itself, and of POST /v1/sign-in/verify for a device still counting in another space (its access was cut from there within its 24 hours), when the device already left a space less than 24 hours ago. `retryAt` (also sent as `Retry-After`) is when it may leave one again; `currentSpaceEmail` names the space it stays attached to, or counts in.

detached.description: 401 of any bearer call from a device that was detached (from another device, from the web, by itself, or by being attached to another space), GET /v1/space included. The application erases the copy of that space it keeps, then shows the sign-in.
